build_flags.detail: 242 of 242 translation units do NOT carry -ffp-contract=off (first: ../../src/Core/AI.m). Without it clang may fuse a*b+c into a single FMA, which rounds once instead of twice and changes the low bits of every float in the dump - exactly the cross-platform variation the golden policy exists to remove.

note: Scenario 007 JS interface (bead oo-5k2): stages the in-tree 'JavaScript Interface Tests' test-oxp into a private addons root and runs ITS OWN test rig (ooRunTests) inside a live game. Evidence block carries the RIG'S OWN output - completion line, per-test pass/fail counts, and a SHA-256 of the sorted test-name set, a field that cannot exist unless the expansion's scripts ran. The fixture ships no manifest.plist (bead oo-kcrw NOMANIF): its 2 error lines are allow-listed by exact message and EXACT count, and the count is pinned in the dump. 6/6 runs byte-identical. See tests/golden/staging/007-js-interface/README.md.
